comment: I oppose the Mayor's arbitrary decision to ban public comment at City Council meetings. I understand the frustration of dealing directly with unruly citizens lacking in social graces, however, as THE Mayor she has power to evict ANY resident who is disrespectful to any attendee without making it permanent! I, for one look forward to the reinstatement of public comments from City Council attendees who respond to appropriate questions with respect. St. George residents deserve nothing less. Thank you for your attention to this issue. Sincerely yours, Jeanne Black

comment: Has any study been done on left turn crashes at stop lights? The reason I'm asking is I think the programing of the lights may be partially to blame. For example, today (5/25) I was at the light at westbound Red Cliffs Dr to make a left onto Mall Dr at 4:30pm. During 2 cycles of the lights, the left turn arrow from Red Cliffs to Mall never turned green, went to immediate flashing yellow. With the heavy traffic this time of day, I witnessed several vehicles chance their luck to make the left turn. Motorists frustration with not getting the green arrow causes them to take unnecessary chances which ultimately is going to lead to accidents. I can see flashing yellow in the overnight hours but with the growth of St George and the obvious increase in traffic, it's time to revisit this practice. Similar situation exists at Mall Dr and Riverside Dr. and I'm sure other locations in the city as well. Thank you.
